$comment: AGL-2486. The allowlist for libs/aglyn/src/index.ts. The published customer page no longer opens the barrel with a VALUE namespace — AGL-2706 moved `apps/tenant/app/[host]/[scheme]/[[...slug]]/catch-all-client.tsx` onto subpaths and a type-only namespace, and it now reaches `libs/aglyn/src/index.ts` not at all. The allowlist still holds, because the barrel is one named import away from that page (the tenant instance hooks open it by name) and squarely inside the console shell and the seven besigner editors — and because `lib/aglyn.ts` builds a module-scope singleton, so naming ONE export off it evaluates the whole module. `specifiers` is what the barrel names directly; `packages` is every third-party package its transitive graph reaches. Two got in unnoticed before this file existed: `firebase/auth` (through the @aglyn/shared-data-enums barrel, -48,643 B gz to remove) and `acorn` (through app-utils/server.ts re-exporting plugin-bundle-checks, -39,035 B gz). Move either list only with `npm run check:aglyn-barrel -- --write`, in the same commit as the import that moved it. See tools/scripts/lib/jsx-barrel.mjs.
